name: Driftgloom Coyote
description: When this creature enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until this creature leaves the battlefield. If that creature had power 2 or less, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
assumptions: Treated the exile and the conditional counter as one continuous printed ability (no stack interruption between them).
notes: First attempt missed the ConditionDefined$Targeted + ConditionPresent$ Creature.powerLE2 gate entirely ("If that creature had power 2 or less"), reconstructing the counter as unconditional. Fixed: added a narrow if_targeted_<stat>_<le|ge>=<N> flag to PutCounter for this ConditionDefined$Targeted+ConditionPresent$ shape -- a single-object property check on the earlier target, distinct from the general cross-player ConditionCheckSVar$ class (see known_gap_classes). Verified directly against the regenerated packet: node E now shows cond:delta=+1/+1counter;if_targeted_power_le=2, an exact match. In blb-success.json.
